author: b0died
body:
• Your minecraft username (most recent name if changed)
  • Reigned (I was Kodae when I was banned)
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned
  • DDoS Threats
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server.
  • I wanted to be banned because I couldn't use my will power to keep myself from coming on Avicus because I was addicted. But now, I got my life in line and my grades are good so I feel as if I can come back now because I fixed all my problems (or most).
  • Was my temp-ban or ban really false?
  • It was not false, it was as true as it gets.
  • Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false?
  • No, it was true.
  • Have I waited long enough to be un-banned?
  • I am not sure if 2 months or around is a long enough wait but I can at least try, hopefully it is because I am ready to come back.
  • Have I been caught ban evading?
  • Not really, the only other person that plays on my IP is Chatmin (my brother) and rex (my cousin)
  • Have I appealed a ban before?
  • No, this is my first time ever.

title: Appeal

replies.author: Iron
replies.body: Thanks for the appeal, we will look at it shortly!
replies.body_tagged: Thanks for the appeal, we will look at it shortly!

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

First and foremost, sorry for the late reply on your appeal. You've admitted to sending DDoS threats and you're reason for doing it was unnecessary. Whether you wanted to get banned on your own accord or not, exceptions cannot be made and you will have to wait out your ban.

You may create another appeal regarding this situation in 4-6 months as it is currently denied.
